messages:
sara_sales: Heads up 1 Exec escalation: Meridian Health wants bystander SSO validation, KMS BYO, and an explicit SLA for 99.95% for pilot. They want all answers by Wed.

evan_se: Do they require BYO for all data or only encryption-at-rest? Can we scope it to rest only?

maria_ciso: Meridian CISO here 1 They require BYO for patient data only. Also asking for SOC2 type II snapshot and incident response contact.

ops_infra: For BYO KMS we need customer KMS credentials + validated IAM role. ETA ~4 days for onboarding. Ticket INF-6899 created.

ticket-bot: Ticket INF-6899 created by ops_infra: https://tracker.redwood/INF-6899

cto_yang: SLA for pilot 1 We can commit to 99.95% availability on Dedicated with the standard maintenance window exclusion. We should add a clause that pilot SLA is measured on the dedicated tenant only.

legal_ops: Will prepare SOW addendum with SLA language + incident response contact field. Need confirmed incident contact and KMS onboarding timeline.

sara_sales: I'll gather incident contact + push customer for KMS creds earlier. Also confirm pilot budget cap: they asked for $3k/mo for 2 months. Is that acceptable?

evans_se: Engineering OK with $3k pilot. Need to note that advanced telemetry features are not included in pilot.

maria_ciso: Acceptable. Will provide incident contact and PO cadence.

ops_infra: INF-6899 updated: onboarding checklist attached: /artifacts/meridian/kms_onboard_checklist.md. ETA remains 4 days once creds received.

legal_ops: Drafted SOW addendum, uploaded to /legal/drafts/meridian_sow_addendum.docx. Includes SLA 99.95% measured on tenant, incident response contact placeholder, and KMS onboarding steps.

sara_sales: Sending SOW addendum to Meridian now. Target to close pilot by Thu.

ticket-bot: INF-6899 status changed: "Onboarding pending creds" by ops_infra.

sara_sales: Update: Meridian provided PO and incident contact. PO is net-30. Marking this as resolved from exec ":thumbsup:"

cto_yang: Thanks team. We'll schedule onboarding after creds are validated.

evan_se: Note: add a follow-up to educate customer that telemetry features require extended license.

sara_sales: Will capture that in the post-sign email. Closing thread."
